title: Shabbir ki dukhtar
body:
Dafatan Shabbir ki Dukhtar ka Rona Tham Gaya
Har Ghadi Zulmat ki Manzil se Guzarna Tham Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aabid e Dilgeer se puche Na Haal e Dil koi
Aisa Lagta hai Ki Uska Saa'ns Lena Tham Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zainab e Khasta jigar hai'n Khaak pe Nauhakuna
Baap ki Furqat me Beti ka Machalna Tham Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maadar e Muztar ki Khaatir kya Raha Ab Zeest me
Goad me lekar Sakina ko Sulana tham Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aye Yazeed e Badgohar Ab Chayn se Soyega tu
Bachchi ka ro rokar Baba bulana tham Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ghul huwa k Qaidkhane me Sakina Mar Gayi
Gham me Baba k Musalsal Roz Marna Tham Gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Doobkar Apne hi Aa'nsu me 'Wila' mera Qalam
Likh kar Aakhir me Faqat haaye Sakina Tham Gaya
